ruleUpdate: On AMD DL3X5 Gen11 platforms, Standard Fan Kit (P58464-B21, $157) is ordered as individual fan modules (4 for 1P = $628, 6 for 2P = $942). In contrast, Performance Fan Kit (P58465-B21, $160) is packaged as a complete chassis kit (max 1 per server = $160 total). OCA enforces mutual exclusion between Standard and Performance fan kits (RULE_25/TEXT_63). In standard 8SFF with Performance Heatsinks (P58459-B21) and Air Baffle (P57886-B21), OCA accepts 6x P58464-B21. However, P58465-B21 (Performance Fan Kit, Qty 1) is the recommended presales best practice whenever customer drive types (BYOD NVMe SSDs) or drive cage expansions are unspecified, providing superior CFM airflow, static pressure, and thermal headroom at lower total list price ($160 vs $942 in OCA).
rawMessage: AMD DL3X5 Gen11 Fan Module Granularity, Thermal Envelope & Presales Best Practice (INV-183). P58464-B21 is individual fan module (6 for 2P = $942), P58465-B21 is complete chassis kit (1 kit = $160, max 1). Mutual exclusion enforced. Performance fan kit recommended for customer BYOD NVMe/cages.
provenance: INV-183, OCA RULE_25/TEXT_63, and live OCA configurator validation

ruleUpdate: When modernizing AMD EPYC 7543 (32c, 2.8GHz, 256MB L3, 225W), EPYC 9334 (32c, 2.7GHz, 128MB L3, 210W, ,170 USD) saves CapEx but halves L3 cache from 256MB to 128MB due to 4-CCD topology. For memory-latency and database workloads, EPYC 9354 (32c, 3.25GHz, 256MB L3, 280W, ,861 USD) restores full 256MB L3 cache and exceeds base clock (+0.45GHz) for +,820 USD list price across 10 servers. Chassis cooling (60x P58465-B21 performance fans + 20x P58459-B21 performance heatsinks) is already 100% qualified for 280W. Dual-track options must be presented to facilitate commercial negotiations (INV-184).
